mentions.name: Cross-device roaming context-focused UI
mentions.description: A cross-device roaming, context-focused UI that binds a user's devices, tools, and applications to a work context (e.g. work://customer-foo/project-bar/task-baz), so that switching tasks makes every bound device, tool, or application load the data related to that task — relevant files mounted, browser tabs opened, and notes loaded. A custom small database engine is being built to support this use-case, with the goal of making context switching across customer devices cheap.
mentions.problem: Switching context is very expensive, especially when working across multiple customer devices, and native Linux UI tooling was too poor to support the needed context-focused experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building my "dream tool" too, a cross-device roaming profile-experience context-focused UI.
